review_candidates.description: Voor een groeiende organisatie binnen de technische dienstverlening zijn wij op zoek naar een Management Assistent. In deze veelzijdige functie ben jij de rechterhand van de directie en zorg je ervoor dat alles achter de schermen soepel verloopt. Je houdt overzicht, stelt prioriteiten en weet precies wat er geregeld moet worden. Naast de ondersteuning van de directie speel je een belangrijke rol binnen de binnendienst. Je schakelt gemakkelijk tussen verschillende organisatorische, administratieve en facilitaire werkzaamheden en krijgt daarbij veel ruimte voor eigen verantwoordelijkheid. Ben jij organisatorisch sterk, communicatief vaardig en krijg jij energie van regelen, organiseren en vooruitdenken? Dan komen wij graag met je in contact. Omschrijving Als Management Assistent ben jij de rechterhand van de directie en zorg je ervoor dat alles achter de schermen soepel verloopt. Je houdt overzicht, stelt prioriteiten en schakelt gemakkelijk tussen verschillende werkzaamheden. Naast de directe ondersteuning van het management zorg je er ook voor dat de binnendienst goed georganiseerd blijft. Beheren van complexe agenda’s en stellen van prioriteiten; Voorbereiden van MT-vergaderingen en bewaken van actiepunten; Opstellen van notulen en verzorgen van correspondentie namens het management; Opstellen van rapportages en presentaties; Organiseren van bijeenkomsten en ondersteunen bij facilitaire en administratieve zaken. Eisen Voor deze functie zoeken wij iemand die van nature gestructureerd werkt en gemakkelijk overzicht bewaart. Je denkt vooruit, schakelt snel wanneer prioriteiten veranderen en gaat zorgvuldig om met vertrouwelijke informatie. Daarnaast voel je je prettig binnen een informele organisatie waar initiatief en zelfstandigheid worden gewaardeerd. MBO+ / HBO werk- en denkniveau; Een passende opleiding richting Management, Secretariaat of vergelijkbaar; Ervaring in een soortgelijke ondersteunende functie; Goede organisatorische, administratieve en communicatieve vaardigheden; Een nauwkeurige, zelfstandige, proactieve en discrete werkhouding. Wat wij bieden Je komt terecht binnen een nuchtere en informele organisatie waar samenwerking en eigen verantwoordelijkheid centraal staan. Je krijgt veel vrijheid in je functie en volop ruimte om jezelf verder te ontwikkelen. Een salaris tussen € 3.500 en € 4.800 bruto per maand op basis van 40 uur; Een dienstverband van 32 tot 40 uur per week; 25 vakantiedagen en 13 ADV-dagen bij een fulltime dienstverband; CAO Technische Installatiebedrijf met uitstekende secundaire voorwaarden; Opleidingsmogelijkheden, medewerkerskortingen en veel ruimte voor eigen verantwoordelijkheid. Over de opdrachtgever Onze opdrachtgever is een ervaren organisatie binnen de technische dienstverlening en houdt zich bezig met gebouwgebonden installaties, verduurzaming en technisch beheer. Vanuit Maarsbergen werken zij aan uiteenlopende technische vraagstukken voor verschillende opdrachtgevers, waarbij kwaliteit, betrouwbaarheid en langdurige samenwerkingen centraal staan. Binnen de organisatie heerst een nuchtere en informele werksfeer met korte lijnen. Medewerkers krijgen veel zelfstandigheid en verantwoordelijkheid en worden gestimuleerd om mee te denken en initiatief te nemen. Je komt terecht in een betrokken team waar samenwerking en persoonlijke ontwikkeling belangrijk zijn.

review_candidates.title: Law and Policy Outreach Associate
review_candidates.company: International Committee of the Red Cross - ICRC
review_candidates.description: About The ICRC Since 1863, the International Committee of the Red Cross (ICRC) has worked to preserve human dignity and relieve suffering caused by war and armed violence. In collaboration with our Red Cross and Red Crescent partners around the world, we do everything we can to deliver life-saving aid, reconnect families and locate missing people – helping those who need it most, regardless of who they are and what side of the front line they are on. We engage with authorities and armed forces on all sides, often confidentially, pressing for access to detainees to improve their living conditions and urging compliance with international humanitarian law to protect non-combatants, including from digital threats. Purpose of the Role The Law and Policy Outreach Unit is offering a one-year paid traineeship as an Associate, entailing the following tasks: internal and external communications planning, digital content marketing, web editing and publishing, and contact and information management. The Associate will work under the supervision of the Law and Policy Outreach Advisor and in close collaboration with other team members. About The Law And Policy Outreach Unit Within the International Law, Movement and Partnerships Department (LMP), the Law and Policy Outreach Unit leads the ICRC's online and onsite outreach to law and policy circles in support of influencing key actors and decision-makers on humanitarian issues. It brings together multidisciplinary outreach capacities, encompassing the Humanitarian Law and Policy blog, work on online platforms, onsite and online events, and digital promotion strategies. Relying on the expertise and substance developed within the broader Department, the unit: offers platforms to position and promote the ICRC's law and policy content (including the International Review of the Red Cross website, the IHL in Action website and the How Does Law Protect in War? Online Casebook website); fosters debate on law and policy through the Humanitarian Law and Policy blog and the organization of thematic events with a global reach; offers digital tools and communication advice to promote the ICRC's law and policy publications, events and initiatives through digital means (the monthly Law and Policy newsletter, the thematic Law and Policy newsletter, the quarterly internal LMP in Touch newsletter, and social media campaigns); develops and maintains solid expertise in organizing onsite and online events, providing guidance on events designed to foster debate on IHL, other relevant norms and related policies and positions, including those dealing more broadly with humanitarian action. Main Duties & Responsibilities Reporting to the Law and Policy Outreach Advisor, under the overall supervision of the Head of Unit, the Law and Policy Outreach Associate will support the implementation of the Law and Policy digital outreach strategy. The Associate will also maintain and develop the Law and Policy Outreach Unit's digital outreach tools and support the promotion and production of its activities and events throughout the year. Supporting and implementing the Law and Policy digital outreach strategy Digital marketing campaigns and communication plans. Support the development and implementation of targeted digital marketing campaigns on LinkedIn (and other social media if needed). This includes drafting campaign content, adapting messaging and visuals to target audiences, and coordinating inputs and approvals with relevant colleagues. Design and implement communication plans for the unit's activities (and, at times, for activities of the International Law, Movement and Partnerships Department) by creating promotional content such as emails, social media posts and graphics. Social media and content creation. Maintain and expand the unit's social media accounts, assessing and building on the best strategies for reaching key target audiences. Liaise with the unit's Graphic Designer, the Digital Communications Unit and other relevant departments to promote the unit's activities through ICRC social media channels. Create and curate content that promotes blogs, events and activities and also advocates for international humanitarian law (IHL) as a whole. Keep the accounts active, engaging and growing by sharing relevant updates, insights and resources on IHL and the broader humanitarian sector. Audiovisual production. Support the production of audiovisual content by filming interviews, events and other footage, following agreed storylines, technical requirements and visual identity guidelines. Maintaining and developing the unit's digital outreach tools External and internal newsletters. Gather, edit and send regular newsletter content through HubSpot and on LinkedIn. Digital marketing: mailing. Contribute to editing and emailing content as needed, such as the Humanitarian Law and Policy blog. Support the development and implementation of a segmentation approach for the subscriber base, working closely with the Digital Unit and other key units on email campaign strategies and engagement. Contact database. Regularly update the unit's mailing list and map its audience so the unit can engage efficiently with specific target groups. Help develop the contact database. Law and Policy web platforms. Keep the web platforms regularly updated by creating, editing and publishing content. Humanitarian Law and Policy blog. Ensure the efficient preparation and dissemination of blog content, and help the Editor-in-Chief build the blog's audience and stimulate engagement. International Review of the Red Cross. Assist with producing promotional materials for each edition of the Review, including related events and their promotion. Promotion and production support for LMP events Enhance the visibility of LMP events by developing external and internal communication strategies. Support the overall organization of events by planning and running promotional campaigns, in close collaboration with other ICRC units and partner institutions. Collaborate with Communications and other units to create promotional content for events and activities, including taking photos. Required Profile & Skills Advanced university degree in Communications, International Relations, Journalism, Marketing, Media or another relevant field. A minimum of 1 year to a maximum of 2 years of previous work experience (including internships) is required. Demonstrated experience in digital media and communications, in particular digital marketing, social media content development and audiovisual production. Demonstrated experience with design and video editing tools such as Adobe Creative Suite and Canva. Availability for the full one-year assignment. Keen interest in international humanitarian law and/or humanitarian action, as well as in digital communication and technologies. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to create compelling, concise content for different digital platforms. Strong analytical and organizational skills. Initiative and the ability to work autonomously while juggling multiple tasks. Proven ability to work as part of a team in a multicultural environment. Proficiency in English. Knowledge of other languages, particularly French, Arabic or Spanish, is an advantage given the ICRC's global audience. Experience with email campaigns and analytics tools such as Google Analytics or Tableau is an advantage. Experience with contact management tools such as HubSpot or Mailchimp is an advantage. Experience with web content management systems and web development is an advantage. Additional Information Location: Geneva, Switzerland Activity rate: 100% Start date: 1 March 2027 Length of Assignment: 12 months Visa/permit: Legitimation Card - Provided Gross Monthly Salary: CHF 3'934 (paid in 13 installments) Application deadline: Friday, 23 October 2026 Please note: This traineeship is open to candidates with a maximum professional experience of two years , of which no more than one year is in a full-time paid position after completion of studies. Strong analytical, problem-solving, project management, and transaction execution capabilities. review_candidates.title: Investigations & Law Enforcement Development Specialist, Malaysia
review_candidates.description: Who We Are International Justice Mission (IJM) is the global leader in protecting vulnerable people from violence around the world. Our team of over 1,200 professionals are at work worldwide in over 30 offices. Together we are on a mission to rescue millions, protect half a billion, and make justice unstoppable. We are a global community that cares for one another. We believe that the way we work is as important as the results we achieve. We provide professional excellence with joy and celebration to all those we serve. The Need For over 25 years, IJM has pioneered the work to protect vulnerable people from violence. 9 out of 9 times in the last decade, IJM’s Justice System Strengthening Projects have reduced slavery and violence between 50 and 85% for very large populations of people in poverty. As we grow to expand our impact to protect 500 million people from violence, we are seeking an Investigation & Law Enforcement Development Specialist to support implementation of IJM Malaysia’s Investigations and Law Enforcement Development (ILED) strategy by providing sustained operational engagement with law enforcement, investigation and intelligence support, proactive case development, case progression, and capacity development focused on trafficking in persons and forced labour. Working closely with the ILED Manager and IJM’s Casework, Legal, Aftercare and Program teams, the specialist strengthens case quality, victim identification, evidence development, inter-agency coordination and accountability outcomes while building trusted professional relationships with Malaysian justice-sector partners. The specialist generates field-level information, intelligence, case insights and operational analysis to inform strategic decisions led by the ILED Manager and is expected to operate with professional discretion, sound investigative judgment, a survivor-centered and trauma-informed approach, and a strong understanding of the Malaysian law enforcement environment. This position is based in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia and reports to Law Enforcement Development Manager, Malaysia and is only available for candidates with the right to work in Malaysia. Responsibilities Casework Proactively identify, assess and develop promising trafficking and forced labour case opportunities through lawful intelligence gathering, stakeholder engagement, referrals, open-source information and analysis; develop well-supported leads and case-development recommendations for assessment and prioritization by the ILED Manager; Provide hands-on investigation and intelligence support for IJM-supported trafficking and forced labour matters, including evidence review, investigative gap analysis, development of investigative hypotheses, OSINT, information assessment and preparation of operational recommendations; Support victim and witness engagement, interviews and referrals in coordination with appropriate IJM teams and government partners, applying trauma-informed, survivor-centered and culturally appropriate practices; Follow up on agreed investigative actions and case-development steps to maintain momentum throughout the lifecycle of priority cases. Fieldwork Projects Participate in approved field-based investigative and case-support activities, including joint field visits, victim identification activities, stakeholder meetings, and engagement with law enforcement, prosecutors and other justice-sector partners as appropriate; Travel throughout Malaysia as required to support priority casework and law enforcement engagement, documenting relevant observations, risks and recommended follow-up actions. Networking & Partnership Build and maintain trusted professional relationships with investigators, operational leaders and focal points within RMP/PDRM, JIM, MAPO, JTKSM, AGC and other relevant government or civil-society partners; Facilitate authorized communication, case conferences, referrals, information sharing and coordination among IJM and external stakeholders to support victim identification, investigation progression and prosecution readiness; Track relevant agency structures, focal points and personnel changes to preserve continuity of engagement and reduce disruption to priority investigations; Support cross-border coordination and information exchange with IJM regional offices and approved international partners when cases involve transnational recruitment, movement, exploitation or repatriation. Research, Program Management and M&E Analyze casework, partner-engagement and trafficking-trend information to identify emerging patterns, recurring risks and operational implications relevant to ILED casework and partner support; Contribute operational data and analysis to case reviews, program monitoring and learning, including identification of progress, risks, lessons and recommended follow-up actions. Training and Development Support the design and delivery of practical training, mentoring, workshops and technical consultations for law enforcement, immigration, labour and other justice-sector partners on victim identification, investigative methods, evidence development, interviewing and inter-agency coordination; Provide case-based coaching during active matters and identify recurring capability gaps that should inform future ILED capacity-development initiatives; Contribute to the development and adaptation of practical tools, guidance and protocols that support sustainable improvements in trafficking and forced labour investigations. Strategy & Knowledge Development & Implementation Maintain a current understanding of relevant Malaysian legal frameworks, agency mandates, investigative procedures and operational practices, and apply this knowledge to support effective ILED casework and law enforcement engagement; Systematically identify and document recurring investigative, operational and coordination bottlenecks encountered by law enforcement partners through casework and partner engagement and provide evidence-based analysis to the ILED Manager to inform technical assistance, intervention design and capacity-development priorities. Documentation, Reporting & Data Management Prepare clear and timely case summaries, intelligence notes, investigation briefs, stakeholder updates and program reports for internal decision-making and approved external engagement; Maintain accurate case and stakeholder records in IJM-approved systems and ensure sensitive information is handled in accordance with confidentiality, safeguarding, security and data-protection requirements; Document and synthesize lessons, emerging trends, investigative patterns and good practices from casework and partner engagement to strengthen IJM Malaysia’s institutional knowledge and casework capability. General tasks Provide routine investigative and operational coordination support arising from active casework and partner engagement, as assigned by the ILED Manager and consistent with the scope and authority of the position. Qualifications Education and Experience Bachelor’s degree in law, Criminology, Criminal Justice, Social Sciences or another relevant discipline; Minimum five years of professional experience in criminal investigations, investigative intelligence, law enforcement, prosecution or another operational investigative role; Demonstrated experience supporting criminal investigations, evidence development and investigative interviews with victims, witnesses or persons of interest; Demonstrated experience working directly with law enforcement or justice-sector agencies during active investigations or case progression; Experience in trafficking in persons, forced labour, organized crime, migrant-worker exploitation or related complex investigations is highly desirable; Experience working within the Malaysian law enforcement or criminal justice context and across multiple government agencies is strongly preferred; Willingness and ability to travel regularly throughout Malaysia; Malaysian driving licence or ability to obtain one is preferred. Strong criminal investigation and case-development skills, including evidence assessment, investigative planning, interviewing, intelligence analysis and identification of evidential gaps; Ability to conduct and document OSINT and other lawful information-development activities, assess source credibility and produce concise intelligence or investigation products; Ability to translate investigative findings into practical recommendations for law enforcement coordination, victim protection and prosecution readiness; Experience supporting training, mentoring or technical assistance for law enforcement or other justice-sector practitioners; Strong professional writing and digital literacy, including proficiency with Microsoft Office and case/information management systems; Strong oral and written communication skills in Bahasa Malaysia and English. Critical Qualities High integrity, discretion and sound professional judgment when handling sensitive case, survivor and law enforcement information; Strong investigative mindset, professional curiosity and initiative; able to identify opportunities and problems without waiting for detailed direction; Analytical, organized and results-oriented, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and maintain consistent follow-up; Strong interpersonal, networking and relationship-building skills, with diplomacy and cultural sensitivity in multi-agency and cross-cultural environments; Able to work independently with limited supervision while collaborating effectively across multidisciplinary teams; Resilient and composed under pressure, receptive to feedback, and able to adapt to changing operational priorities; Demonstrated commitment to survivor-centered, trauma-informed practice and to IJM’s mission, values, safeguarding standards and Code of Ethics. Application Process Please submit your Resume/CV and Cover Letter to IJM@monroeconsulting.com not later than 23 October 2026 . Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted. IJM holds strict safeguarding principles and a zero tolerance to violations of the Safeguarding Policy, Protection against Sexual Exploitation, Abuse and Harassment Policy, and Code of Ethics. Candidate selection is based on technical competence, recruitment, selection and hiring criteria subject to assess the candidates value congruence and thorough background, police clearance, and reference check processes.

review_candidates.title: Gestor de Operações de TI
review_candidates.description: Job Description Procuramos um(a) Gestor de Operações de TI para liderar a gestão e operação do ambiente tecnológico, assegurando a disponibilidade, estabilidade, eficiência e evolução contínua da infraestrutura de IT. Esta é uma oportunidade para um profissional com forte experiência técnica e capacidade de liderança, que queira fazer parte de um ambiente dinâmico, orientado para a inovação, excelência operacional e qualidade de serviço. Como Gestor(a) de Operações de TI, será responsável por garantir uma operação tecnológica robusta e eficiente, abrangendo infraestrutura, servidores, redes, ambientes de desktop, bases de dados e sistemas integrados, assegurando simultaneamente a gestão das equipas e o alinhamento da tecnologia com as necessidades do negócio. As Principais Responsabilidades Incluem Gestão financeira e eficiência Gerir custos e recursos de IT, assegurando uma utilização eficiente do orçamento. Definir, alinhar e acompanhar metas e orçamentos das áreas sob sua responsabilidade. Promover uma utilização eficiente e sustentável dos sistemas e recursos tecnológicos. Identificar oportunidades para aumentar a eficiência operacional e reduzir custos. Experiência do cliente e parceria com o negócio Promover uma forte cultura de serviço dentro da área de IT. Construir relações de parceria com utilizadores, especialistas técnicos, gestores de projectos e stakeholders séniores. Contribuir para a definição e tradução das necessidades do negócio em soluções tecnológicas. Promover inovação e uma experiência de serviço de excelência para os clientes internos. Operações e tecnologia Gerir, monitorizar e assegurar a continuidade das operações de diferentes plataformas tecnológicas, incluindo servidores, computadores, redes, Helpdesk e ambientes empresariais. Garantir a estabilidade e disponibilidade do ambiente de produção. Coordenar o suporte operacional e a automação dos ambientes tecnológicos. Assegurar a gestão de incidentes e problemas, intervindo e escalando quando necessário. Garantir que contratos de hardware, software e Service Level Agreements (SLA) estejam actualizados e que os níveis de serviço acordados sejam cumpridos. Assegurar a implementação e cumprimento dos requisitos de IT Governance, auditoria e legislação aplicável. Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com equipas técnicas e de desenvolvimento para garantir a continuidade e qualidade dos serviços de IT. Liderança e desenvolvimento de pessoas Liderar, desenvolver e gerir o desempenho das equipas sob sua responsabilidade. Identificar necessidades de desenvolvimento e fortalecer competências técnicas e de liderança. Promover uma cultura de inovação, colaboração, eficiência e elevada performance. Desenvolver talento e criar um ambiente que permita às equipas evoluir e entregar resultados sustentáveis. Transformar conhecimento e novas ideias em processos e serviços melhorados. O que procuramos? Procuramos um profissional que combine forte conhecimento técnico, capacidade de liderança, orientação para resultados e visão de negócio. Requisitos Mínimos Licenciatura em Sistemas de Informação, Ciência da Computação ou área relacionada. Certificações técnicas relevantes serão valorizadas, tais como MCSE, CCIE, MS SQL+, RHCE ou RHCA. 5 a 7 anos de experiência profissional relevante em operações de IT, infraestrutura ou áreas relacionadas. Experiência em gestão de equipas e fornecedores. Experiência em gestão de ambientes de produção, redes, servidores, bases de dados e suporte tecnológico. Conhecimento de IT Governance, gestão de incidentes, problemas, SLA e gestão de serviços. Capacidade de trabalhar com diferentes stakeholders e traduzir necessidades do negócio em soluções práticas. Competências Que Farão a Diferença Planeamento e organização – capacidade de estruturar prioridades, recursos e actividades para garantir uma execução eficiente. Inovação e criatividade – procura activa de novas ideias, métodos e soluções. Gestão de programas e projectos – capacidade de planear, acompanhar e entregar iniciativas com impacto. Agilidade de aprendizagem – facilidade em adquirir novos conhecimentos e adaptar-se a novas tecnologias e formas de trabalhar. Tomada de decisão e orientação para a acção – capacidade de tomar decisões com confiança, avaliar riscos e assumir responsabilidade pelos resultados. Gestão de conflitos – capacidade de promover entendimento e resolver diferentes perspectivas de forma construtiva. Objectividade – capacidade de analisar situações de forma imparcial e baseada em factos. Julgamento ético – compromisso com elevados padrões de integridade, ética e governação. Construção de relações estratégicas – capacidade de criar relações de confiança e redes de colaboração dentro e fora da organização. Capacidade analítica e numérica – facilidade em interpretar dados e utilizá-los para suportar decisões. Porquê esta oportunidade? Se é um profissional de IT que gosta de resolver problemas complexos, liderar equipas, melhorar operações e transformar tecnologia em valor para o negócio, esta pode ser a próxima oportunidade para si. Venha fazer parte de uma equipa onde tecnologia, inovação, pessoas e negócio trabalham em conjunto para construir soluções que fazem a diferença. Candidate-se e faça parte desta transformação. #Post #FNB Important Closing Date Note Take note that applications will not be accepted on the below date and onwards, kindly submit applications ahead of the closing date indicated below. 16/10/26 All appointments will be made in line with FirstRand Group’s Employment Equity plan. review_candidates.title: Gestionnaire de campagnes publicitaires Google
review_candidates.description: J7 Media est une agence de marketing numérique qui gère plus de 5 millions de dollars en publicités Facebook mensuellement. De la stratégie à la création, notre objectif est d’accélérer la croissance de nos clients. Chez J7 Media, nous ne faisons pas de marketing « à la Emilie à Paris ». Ici, le rôle de stratège en performance et marketing direct est fait pour les esprits analytiques, techniques et stratégiques qui aiment voir l’impact direct de leur travail sur les résultats des clients. Tu seras responsable de la gestion de comptes clients en publicité numérique, en veillant non seulement à optimiser leurs campagnes publicitaires sur Google . Ce poste est fait pour toi si tu es à la fois rigoureux(se) avec les chiffres, proactif(ve) dans la gestion client, et passionné(e) par la performance marketing. RESPONSABILITÉS 🏆 Stratégie et gestion client Entretenir une relation de confiance avec tes clients. Définir et ajuster la stratégie marketing pour maximiser la rentabilité des campagnes. Analyser les résultats et conseiller les clients sur l’optimisation de leur budget publicitaire. Planifier et animer des rencontres clients pour présenter les stratégies et bilans de performance. Coordonner avec l’équipe créative la production de visuels et de textes adaptés aux campagnes. Gérer les plaintes et situations difficiles avec professionnalisme et proactivité. 📈 Optimisation des campagnes publicitaires et marketing direct Concevoir, tester et optimiser des campagnes Google Ads. Gérer les données clients et assurer le suivi des indicateurs de performance clés : CPC, CPA,ROI, TCR, TCV, etc. Travailler avec des outils comme Google Business Manager et Google Analytics; Collaborer avec tes collègues des autres départements pour le suivi et l’analyse du parcours client sur le site web ainsi que le email marketing. Collaborer avec les clients pour améliorer leurs fondations financières et structure de prix. CE QU’ON CHERCHE 🔎 Compétences et expérience Expérience d’au moins 3 ans en gestion de campagnes publicitaires sur les plateformes Google. Au moins un an d'expérience en agence. Solides connaissances en marketing de réponse directe et acquisition client. Maîtrise de l’outil Google Ads. Maîtrise des campagnes publicitaires Google et de leur fonctionnement : Réseau de Recherche (Search), Shopping, Réseau Display, Performance Max, Génération de prospects (Leadgen), YouTube). Capacité à analyser un compte Shopify et identifier les opportunités d’optimisation. Bilinguisme français / anglais (écrit et oral), afin de communiquer efficacement avec nos clients francophones et anglophones. Un atout : compréhension du suivi et de l’analyse des données marketing (Google Analytics, balises UTM, pixels de suivi). Exigences Être localisé et autorisé à travailler au Canada (ou vouloir le devenir); Être disponible à temps plein, du lundi au vendredi, de 9h à 17h Qualités essentielles ✅ Rigoureux(se) et analytique : tu aimes les chiffres, les rapports de performance et les décisions basées sur les données. ✅ À l'aise avec la technologie (« Tech-savvy ») : tu es à l’aise avec les outils publicitaires, le suivi et l'analyse de donnée, ainsi que l’écosystème e-commerce. ✅ Stratège et orienté(e) résultats : tu veux voir l’impact direct de ton travail sur la croissance des clients. ✅ Excellentes compétences en communication : tu sais vulgariser des concepts techniques à des clients. ✅ Autonome et résilient(e) : ce poste demande de la rigueur et une gestion efficace des priorités. Pourquoi rejoindre J7 Media ? 🚀 ✅ Travailler dans une agence spécialisée en croissance e-commerce et marketing de réponse directe. ✅ Évoluer dans un environnement 100 % télétravail avec des collègues experts en publicité numérique. ✅ Avoir un impact direct sur les résultats des clients, avec des budgets publicitaires conséquents. ✅ Accéder à des formations continues sur les meilleures pratiques en publicité numérique et performance marketing. ✅ Assurances collectives, bonus, horaire d'été, activités d'équipe et plus encore ... 🫱🏻‍🫲🏽 J7 Media valorise la diversité Peu importe ta nationalité, ton genre, ton orientation sexuelle ou ton parcours, on veut travailler avec des personnes talentueuses et passionnées. Tout le monde est bienvenu! 💰Salaire annuel compétitif selon l’expérience.
